route_name: Hermes native AIAgent harness plus existing benchmark and observation adapters
reason: Native stores and tool functions can be reused directly, but preserving the full review, session, prompt-cache, compaction, skill ownership and accounting lifecycle in Pi requires a second lifecycle bridge. Native AIAgent already owns those semantics.
route_A_disqualifiers: Reconstruct or bridge native parent attributes, prompt/tool bytes and session lineage for background AIAgent forks
Reproduce turn and tool-iteration trigger semantics, compaction and persistence ordering in the Pi lifecycle
Coordinate Python native tool state, write-origin context, read-before-write tracking, approval queue, cancellation and commit barriers across the Node/Python boundary
Maintain differential regressions against the native harness on each source update

engineering_estimate.unit: person-days of focused engineering by one developer familiar with the existing harness
engineering_estimate.basis: Expert estimate from reviewed interfaces; not implementation time measured in this task
engineering_estimate.scope: Runnable development S0 with adapters, model-free fixtures, finite canary integration and N/J configuration; excludes S1, complete benchmark runs, final scenarios and paid API wait time

work_packages.name: Task tools, terminal condition and sandbox mapping
Background review, curator startup and settlement barriers
Role ledger, raw transport observation and aggregate budgets
State restore, read-only branches and N/J fixture acceptance

selected_profile_design.entry: run_agent.AIAgent with explicit SessionDB; native loop and finalizer retained
selected_profile_design.api_compatibility: pending packet fixture and later approved canary; old Anthropic adapter is historical evidence only
selected_profile_design.auxiliary_models: same GLM with explicit routing and no silent provider fallback; pending verification

curator.startup_tick: explicit wrapper invokes native maybe_run_curator with native due/idle gates; direct AIAgent alone does not reproduce CLI startup

selected_profile_design.initial_state: Empty task experience, empty USER/MEMORY, empty agent-created skill library, empty session DB; common neutral tool protocol documentation only
selected_profile_design.bundled_task_skill_policy: Do not copy the installed user library or bundled task-solving skills; retain native skills tools and lifecycle. Audit final prompt/skill catalog before freezing.
selected_profile_design.file_access: Guard canonical read_file/search_files names for both main agent and review; only legal work, own skills and legal archive roots
selected_profile_design.cross_profile_search: Reject non-current profile arguments including embedded profile/session links at dispatch; independent per-stream home/root visibility
selected_profile_design.general_terminal_web_mcp_delegation: Not exposed for these benchmark tasks; the native memory review fork remains enabled
selected_profile_design.pending_policy: Preserve native pending writes; never auto-approve. pending is not committed. Unattended native memory replace/remove still stages even when write_approval=false.
selected_profile_design.readonly_policy: Separate immutable source snapshot and ephemeral execution state; reject memory/skill/pending/curator writes, DB history mounted read-only. Whole-profile behavior requires 7.4.3 fixtures.
selected_profile_design.task_boundary: Fresh foreground session per independent task; reuse only own legal durable profile. Drain/account review before next task. Do not carry turns just to reach review thresholds.

common_baselines.N: New Hermes task context, no persistent cross-task notes/history/learned skills or maintenance; same neutral initial instructions and task tools
common_baselines.J: Same Hermes task loop plus existing Jaccard selection over own legal episodes; no native second memory path or review; hash packing and budget before running
common_baselines.old_pi_results: Historical descriptive appendix only; never treat as a contemporary same-harness control

acceptance_gaps: Native GLM foreground/background/compression packets and usage semantics
SUBMIT/ACTION solver termination without skipping finalization or killing background work
Whole-profile snapshot, WAL closure, pending/skills metadata, settled background queue and recovery idempotence
Shared file/search/profile access boundary, including background and skill preprocessing
Full untruncated HTTP payloads, retry identities, per-role unknown usage and aggregate fail-closed budgets
Initial skills catalog and common neutral prompt hashes
